summary: Epic E13 Frontend Testing Complete: Dual-Theme System (Light + Dark Toggle) + Hero Video Background verified. All theme toggle, persistence, hero media, and storefront flows functional across both themes.

design_issues.issue: Video element shows muted=False in browser automation test, though muted attribute is present in HTML. This is likely a browser automation quirk and not a real bug, but worth noting.
